|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Destiny +2 when drawn for destiny. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise (if with Vader or an Imperial leader, may add one instead). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V0-D-grandmofftarkin-2022-07-31-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V0-D-grandmofftarkin-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V0-D-grandmofftarkin-2022-07-31-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V0-D-grandmofftarkin.gif]], 31 July 2022).
